app.name: North
app.brief: A local guide for hiking trails, maps, and nearby places. Warm, outdoors, calm, route-first.

direction.seed: a local guide for hiking trails maps and nearby places warm outdoors calm route first north

thesis: The app is a place: location, movement, and layers give the screen its structure.
summary: A topographic field guide: earthy layers, route lines, and elevation labels.
signature: A route line that connects cards.
treatment: Earthy palette, contour-like rules, distance labels, and layered place cards.

why.note: The brief strongly matches Spatial. The layout, type, and surface decisions come from that family rather than from a generic template.

css.display: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
css.body: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
css.numeric: 'SF Mono', 'Roboto Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

principles: One floating control layer, not five.
Use real geography or real spatial hierarchy.
Cards are annotations, not the page.
avoid: A map with a generic grid of cards over it.
A floating action button with no spatial job.
Decorative contour lines that do not encode data.
signatureMoves: A route line that connects cards.
A vertical district label in the margin.
A floating command bar that follows the canvas.
A map pin that expands into a place card.

platform.ios: Use a full-bleed map or canvas under a floating search field. Use a bottom sheet with detents for place details. Keep the system back gesture. Use SF Symbols and a tab bar for peers.
platform.android: Edge-to-edge map or canvas with a floating search bar. Use a bottom sheet for details. Predictive back. Use a NavigationBar or rail; no FAB unless it creates a place.

screens.home: A map or spatial canvas occupies the top two-thirds, with one floating search/control bar and a bottom sheet preview of the nearest place. The list is an annotation, not a wall of cards.
screens.detail: A place detail: hero image or map, name, distance, one key fact, and actions (directions, save, share). Keep the back gesture and the map position.
screens.compose: A route or place creation flow: search, drop a pin, name it, add a note, save. Show the pin on a map before committing.
screens.profile: A personal atlas: saved places, routes, and trips. Use a map or spatial index, not a generic settings list.

components.button: Rounded 16-24pt, but only for floating controls and primary actions. List rows stay flat.
components.list: Place rows with a small map thumbnail or distance marker, a bold name, and one metadata line. No heavy cards.
components.input: Search field floats over the map with a clear action and recent searches.
components.navigation: Floating search, bottom sheet, tab bar or rail. Keep the system back gesture.
